answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A orchard of per-task receipts records who did what, and the island of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
